evidence.text: The conflict text editor accepts UTF-8 regular files up to 1 MB. Complete-version selection supports regular files up to the 16 MB process/file limit; symlinks and submodules require an external tool. Conflict drafts persist across normal app termination/reopening (300 ms autosave plus a close/quit flush); a crash before the debounce expires can lose the latest keystrokes. Up to 128 drafts and 64 MB of archive data are retained per repository; storage failures are visible and block closing unsaved edits. If Git staging fails after saving (for example, a clean filter fails), the edited file remains on disk for recovery. During rebase, Current is Git's stage 2 (the branch being rebased onto), and Incoming is stage 3 (the replayed commit).
